STUDYQURAN:23:intro/r4.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:23:intro/r4.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:23:intro/r4.claim: After recalling worldly blessings, the surah tells of Noah's struggle against his people's denial and rebuke and his journey in the ark.
STUDYQURAN:23:intro/r4.anchor: the sūrah narrates the story of Noah, his struggles with the denial and rebuke of his people, and his journey in the ark (vv. 23–41)

STUDYQURAN:23:intro/r7.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:23:intro/r7.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:23:intro/r7.claim: The opposition of affluent and powerful people to prophets recurs throughout this surah, as elsewhere in the Quran.
STUDYQURAN:23:intro/r7.anchor: The opposition to prophets by the affluent and powerful is a recurrent theme in this sūrah

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p558/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p558/r1.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p558/r1.claim: Because this story follows Noah's, Abū Ḥayyān takes the people as ʿĀd and their messenger as Hūd, the view of most commentators.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p558/r1.anchor: ذكر هذه القصة عقيب قصة نوح، يظهر أن هؤلاء هم قوم هود والرسول هو هود عليه السلام وهو قول الأكثرين

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p558/r2.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p558/r2.speaker: أبو سليمان الدمشقي والطبري
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p558/r2.claim: They identify the people as Thamūd and the messenger as Ṣāliḥ, pointing out that they were destroyed by the cry, unlike the account of Hūd's people.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p558/r2.anchor: وقال أبو سليمان الدمشقي والطبري: هم ثمود، والرسول صالح عليه السلام

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p558/r3.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p558/r3.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p558/r3.claim: The stories of Noah's people and the later people of Hūd occur in that order in al-Aʿrāf, Hūd, and al-Shuʿarāʾ; the Qur'an also recalls that the audience succeeded Noah's people.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p558/r3.anchor: وقصة قوم هود جاءت في الأعراف، وفي هود، وفي الشعراء بإثر قصة قوم نوح

ASAD-NOTES:23:28#n16/r1.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:23:28#n16/r1.speaker: author
ASAD-NOTES:23:28#n16/r1.claim: Qarn literally means a generation; Asad refers to 6:5 for the term's wider sense.
ASAD-NOTES:23:28#n16/r1.anchor: Lit., "a generation (qarn) of others". For a wider meaning of the term qarn. see surah 6, note 5.

ASAD-NOTES:23:31/r1.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:23:31/r1.speaker: author
ASAD-NOTES:23:31/r1.claim: After earlier peoples, God raised new generations and sent each a messenger from among them to call them to worship Him alone and be conscious of Him.
ASAD-NOTES:23:31/r1.anchor: AND AFTER those [people of old] We gave rise to new generations; (23:32)

ALUSI-FULL:v18p28#3/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v18p28#3/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v18p28#3/r1.claim: After the destruction of Noah's people, God brought another generation into being.
ALUSI-FULL:v18p28#3/r1.anchor: ثم أنشأنا من بعدهم أي من بعد إهلاك قوم نوح عليه السلام ( قرنا آخرين

ALUSI-FULL:v18p28#3/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v18p28#3/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v18p28#3/r2.claim: The next generation is identified as either ʿĀd or Thamūd.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v5p416#2/r9.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v5p416#2/r9.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v5p416#2/r9.claim: After the destruction of Noah's people, God established another generation.

BAYDAWI-FULL:23:31-33/r1.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:23:31-33/r1.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:23:31-33/r1.claim: The later generation may be the people of ʿĀd or Thamūd.

BIQAI-FULL:v5p197/r5.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p197/r5.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p197/r5.claim: The later people did not learn from the destruction before them; they repeated and exceeded their predecessors' behavior, by God's will.
BIQAI-FULL:v5p197/r5.anchor: فارتكبوا مثل أحوالهم , وزادوا على أقوالهم وأفعالهم , لإرادة ذلك من الفاعل المختار

BIQAI-FULL:v5p197/r6.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p197/r6.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p197/r6.claim: The people are left unnamed to let the story apply to every oppressive, self-indulgent nation; the author favors identifying them as ʿĀd because of their bodily strength and size.
BIQAI-FULL:v5p197/r6.anchor: وابهمهم ليصح تنزيل قصتهم على كل من ادعى فيهم الإتراف من الكفرة , ويترجح إرادة عاد لما أعطوا مع ذلك من قوة الأبدان وعظم الأجسام

BIQAI-FULL:v5p197/r7.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p197/r7.speaker: ابن عباس
BIQAI-FULL:v5p197/r7.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās also identifies the later people as ʿĀd.
BIQAI-FULL:v5p197/r7.anchor: وبذلك قال ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما

BIQAI-FULL:v5p197/r8.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p197/r8.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p197/r8.claim: Thamūd is another possible identification, given parallels with their descriptions in al-Shuʿarāʾ and al-Qamar, the punishment by a cry, and their shared objection that the messenger was human.
BIQAI-FULL:v5p197/r8.anchor: وإرادة ثمود لما في ا لشعراء والقمر مما يشابه عبض قولهم هنا

BIQAI-FULL:v5p197/r9.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p197/r9.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p197/r9.claim: Anshaʾnā means that God brought the next people into being, gave them life, and nurtured them.
BIQAI-FULL:v5p197/r9.anchor: أي أحدثنا وأحيينا وربينا بما لنا من العظمة

BIQAI-FULL:v5p197/r10.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p197/r10.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p197/r10.claim: The preposition min is used because the later generation did not occupy the entire interval after its predecessors.

BIQAI-FULL:v5p197/r11.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p197/r11.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p197/r11.claim: Calling them another generation clarifies that they were newly created after the earlier people, not survivors of that people's destruction.

BURSEVI:v6p57#3/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p57#3/r1.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p57#3/r1.claim: Reflecting on prophets and perfected saints shows that most migrated, since living among unjust people offers no security.
BURSEVI:v6p57#3/r1.anchor: ولو تفكرت في أحوال الأنبياء وكمل الأولياء لوجدت أكثرهم مهاجرين

BURSEVI:v6p57#3/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p57#3/r2.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p57#3/r2.claim: Bursevi thanks God for repeated migrations, for Bursa as his home and a good, forgiving town, and for rescue from unjust opponents; his trial turned into deliverance, subjugation into kindness, and majesty into beauty.
BURSEVI:v6p57#3/r2.anchor: يقول الفقير : أحمد الله تعالى على نعمه المتوافرة لا سيما على المهاجرة التي وقعت مرارا

BURSEVI:v6p57#3/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p57#3/r3.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p57#3/r3.claim: The generation established after Noah's people is the people of Ad, as confirmed by the address to them in 7:69.
BURSEVI:v6p57#3/r3.anchor: أوجدنا وأحدثنا من بعد إهلاك قوم نوح

BURSEVI:v6p57#3/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p57#3/r4.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p57#3/r4.claim: Qarn denotes people of one shared period, those living in the same age.
BURSEVI:v6p57#3/r4.anchor: والقرن القوم المقترنون من زمن واحد أي أهل زمان واحد

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p142#2/r1.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p142#2/r1.speaker: الطبري
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p142#2/r1.claim: Al-Ṭabarī identifies the later community as Thamūd and its messenger as Ṣāliḥ.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p142#2/r1.anchor: قال الطبري رحمه الله: إن هذا «القرن» هم ثمود و «رسولهم» صالح

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p142#2/r2.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p142#2/r2.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p142#2/r2.claim: Most reports imply that ʿĀd came earlier, although they were not destroyed by a cry; Ibn ʿAṭiyya notes many possibilities and leaves the matter to God.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p142#2/r2.anchor: وفي جل الروايات ما يقتضي أن قوم عاد أقدم إلا أنهم لم يهلكوا بصيحة

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p471#3/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p471#3/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p471#3/r1.claim: The later generation created after them refers to ʿĀd.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p471#3/r1.anchor: ثم أنشأنا من بعدهم قرنا آخرين يعني عادا

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p474#2/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p474#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p474#2/r1.claim: The generation after Noah is identified by one view as Ad, who succeeded Noah's people, and by another as Thamud, in light of the cry that seized them.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p474#2/r1.anchor: يخبر تعالى أنه أنشأ بعد قوم نوح قرنا آخرين (2) -قيل: المراد بهم عاد، فإنهم كانوا مستخلفين بعدهم. وقيل: المراد بهؤلاء ثمود؛

JISHUMI:v7p5045/r7.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p5045/r7.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v7p5045/r7.claim: إنشاء means bringing something into being without a prior model; another explanation says making it without a cause.

JISHUMI:v7p5045/r8.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p5045/r8.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v7p5045/r8.claim: A قرن is the people of an era, so called because they coexist with one another.
JISHUMI:v7p5045/r8.anchor: والقرن: أهل العصر؛ بمقارنة بعضهم لبعض

JISHUMI:v7p5046/r8.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v7p5046/r8.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v7p5046/r8.claim: The passage turns from Noah’s story to another people: God brought another generation into being after the previous people were destroyed.
JISHUMI:v7p5046/r8.anchor: ثم عطف على قصة نوح قصة قوم آخرين

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p187#2/r1.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p187#2/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p187#2/r1.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās identifies the later community as ʿĀd, the people of Hūd.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p187#2/r1.anchor: عن ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p187#2/r2.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p187#2/r2.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p187#2/r2.claim: Hūd’s reminder that ʿĀd succeeded Noah’s people and the order of prophetic stories in several sūras support the identification.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p187#2/r2.anchor: ومجيء قصة هود على أثر قصة نوح في سورة الأعراف وسورة هود والشعراء

MUQATIL:23:31-34/r1.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:23:31-34/r1.speaker: author
MUQATIL:23:31-34/r1.claim: The new generation after Noah's people is the people of Hud.
MUQATIL:23:31-34/r1.anchor: { ثم أنشأنا } يعنى قوم هود، عليه السلام، { من بعدهم } يعنى من بعد قوم نوح { قرنا آخرين

NASAFI-FULL:v3p121#5/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p121#5/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p121#5/r2.claim: “After them” means after Noah’s people; the new generation was ʿĀd, the people of Hud.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p121#5/r2.anchor: ﴿ من بعدهم ﴾ من بعد قوم نوح ﴿ قرنا آخرين ﴾ هم عاد وقوم هود

NASAFI-FULL:v3p121#5/r3.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p121#5/r3.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p121#5/r3.claim: Hud’s statement that God made his people successors after Noah supports the identification; the stories of Hud follow Noah’s in al-Aʿraf, Hud, and al-Shuʿaraʾ.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p121#5/r3.anchor: ويشهد له قول هود واذكروا إذ جعلكم خلفاء من بعد قوم نوح

QURTUBI-FULL:23:31-32/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:23:31-32/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:23:31-32/r1.claim: The new generation was brought into being after the destruction of Noah's people.
QURTUBI-FULL:23:31-32/r1.anchor: أي من بعد هلاك قوم نوح

QURTUBI-FULL:23:31-32/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:23:31-32/r2.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:23:31-32/r2.claim: One view identifies the later generation as the people of Ad and its messenger as Hud, since no nation arose immediately after Noah except Ad.
QURTUBI-FULL:23:31-32/r2.anchor: لأنه ما كانت أمة أنشئت في إثر قوم نوح إلا عاد

QURTUBI-FULL:23:31-32/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:23:31-32/r3.speaker: قيل
QURTUBI-FULL:23:31-32/r3.claim: Another view identifies them as Thamud and their messenger as Salih, citing their destruction by a cry like the one mentioned in Hud.
QURTUBI-FULL:23:31-32/r3.anchor: يعني صالحا. قالوا: والدليل عليه قوله تعالى آخر الآية

QURTUBI-FULL:23:31-32/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:23:31-32/r4.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:23:31-32/r4.claim: The author notes that the people of Midian, Shuaib's people, were also seized by the cry and therefore could be intended.
QURTUBI-FULL:23:31-32/r4.anchor: وممن أخذ بالصيحة أيضا أصحاب مدين قوم شعيب

STUDYQURAN:23:31/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:23:31/r1.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:23:31/r1.claim: The Quran repeatedly speaks of generations succeeding other generations, as in the cited verses.

STUDYQURAN:23:31/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:23:31/r2.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:23:31/r2.claim: Past generations remind people of the world’s ephemerality and of God’s power to destroy those who ignore His message; 17:17 specifically mentions Noah.
STUDYQURAN:23:31/r2.anchor: The generations of the past are often mentioned as proof of the world’s ephemerality and as reminders of God’s Ability to destroy those who do not heed His message

STUDYQURAN:23:31/r3.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:23:31/r3.speaker: some commentators
STUDYQURAN:23:31/r3.claim: Some commentators speculate that the people meant here were the ʿĀd.

STUDYQURAN:23:31/r4.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:23:31/r4.speaker: some commentators
STUDYQURAN:23:31/r4.claim: Other commentators speculate that the people meant here were the Thamūd.

STUDYQURAN:23:31/r5.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:23:31/r5.speaker: al-Qurṭubī
STUDYQURAN:23:31/r5.claim: Al-Qurṭubī notes that the verse does not explicitly identify the people in question.
STUDYQURAN:23:31/r5.anchor: as al-Qurṭubī notes, there is no explicit identification given in this verse

TABRISI:23:35-40/r2.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:23:35-40/r2.speaker: author
TABRISI:23:35-40/r2.claim: God connects the new community’s account to Noah’s preceding story.
TABRISI:23:35-40/r2.anchor: ثم عطف سبحانه على قصة قوم نوح فقال { ثم أنشأنا من بعدهم }

TABRISI:23:35-40/r3.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:23:35-40/r3.speaker: author
TABRISI:23:35-40/r3.claim: God created another community after Noah’s people; qarn is a group sharing one era.
TABRISI:23:35-40/r3.anchor: أي أحدثنا وخلقنا من بعد قوم نوح { قرنا آخرين } أي جماعة آخرين من الناس

TABRISI:23:35-40/r4.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:23:35-40/r4.speaker: قيل
TABRISI:23:35-40/r4.claim: One identification is ʿAd, the people of Hud, sent after Noah.
TABRISI:23:35-40/r4.anchor: قيل يعني عادا قوم هود لأنه المبعوث بعد نوح

TABRISI:23:35-40/r5.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:23:35-40/r5.speaker: الجبائي
TABRISI:23:35-40/r5.claim: Al-Jubbaʾi identifies them as Thamud because they were destroyed by the blast.
TABRISI:23:35-40/r5.anchor: وقيل: يعني ثمود لأنهم أهلكوا بالصيحة عن الجبائي

THALABI:v7p46/r1.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v7p46/r1.speaker: author
THALABI:v7p46/r1.claim: After destroying the earlier people, God brought a later generation into being.
THALABI:v7p46/r1.anchor: ثم أنشأنا من بعدهم أي أهلكناهم وأحدثنا من بعدهم قرنا آخرين

WAHIDI-BASIT:v15p564#2/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v15p564#2/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v15p564#2/r1.claim: The new generation is Aad, the people of Hud, and the messenger sent among them is Hud.

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:23:27-33/r7.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:23:27-33/r7.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:23:27-33/r7.claim: The later generation God brought into being was the people of ʿAd.

YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p400/r3.author: Yaḥyā b. Sallām
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p400/r3.speaker: author
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p400/r3.claim: The later people created after Noah were the people of 'Ad.
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p400/r3.anchor: {ثم أنشأنا من بعدهم} [المؤمنون: 31] من بعد نوح. {قرنا آخرين} [المؤمنون: 31] يعني عادا

ELMALILI:23:31-41/r1.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:23:31-41/r1.speaker: author
ELMALILI:23:31-41/r1.claim: The later generation is not identified; because Aad and Thamud often follow Noah's people in Qur'anic accounts, Elmalılı considers Aad and Hud likely here.
ELMALILI:23:31-41/r1.anchor: zikrolunduğuna[^2] nazaran bu karndan murad Âd, resûlün de Hûd olması melhuzdur.

ELMALILI:23:31-41/r2.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:23:31-41/r2.speaker: others
ELMALILI:23:31-41/r2.claim: An alternative identification is Thamud and their prophet Salih.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:31/r1.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:31/r1.speaker: Eski müfessirlerin bir kısmı
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:31/r1.claim: Some early commentators identify the unnamed generation as Thamūd and its prophet as Ṣāliḥ.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:31/r1.anchor: Eski müfessirlerin bir kısmı, bu âyetlerde ismi verilmeden kendisinden söz edilen neslin Semûd kavmi ve onlara gönderilen peygamberin Sâlih aleyhisselâm olduğu kanaatindedirler

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:31/r2.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:31/r2.speaker: çoğunluk
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:31/r2.claim: Most commentators identify the unnamed generation as ʿĀd and its prophet as Hūd.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:31/r2.anchor: çoğunluk tarafından ise bu neslin Âd kavmi, peygamberin de Hûd aleyhisselâm olduğu söylenmiştir

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:31/r3.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:31/r3.speaker: Muhammed Esed
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:31/r3.claim: Esed reads the passage as a general reference to recurring patterns in the lives and experiences of all God’s prophets, without naming a particular prophet or people.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:31/r3.anchor: bu âyetlerde belli bir peygamber ve kavimden söz edilmediği

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:31/r4.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:31/r4.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:31/r4.claim: The author agrees with Esed that the passage describes a common prophetic experience rather than one specific prophet and people.
